items.name: a lilac mirror
items.description:
Gazing into the mirror, you see yourself, but with an altered appearance:
You have a soft-featured face with a youthful complexion, some dark glitter dotted with scarlet bee balm winging away from evasive emerald eyes, a tiny star-shaped night diamond nose stud piercing a freckled nose and dimples.  Your lilac hair is shoulder length and wavy, and is worn arranged in pigtails.  You have fair skin with an ethereal radiance and a gracefully slender figure.
You are average height for a Human.
An itsy-bitsy pixie brandishing a vial of violaceous glitter floats lazily around your left arm, glowing with a lustrous sheen against your skin.
You are in your prime.
You have a soft pink bunny nose attached to your nose.  Tiny black whiskers protrude outward, wiggling with your every movement.
You have a tattoo of a double helix symbol of evolution on your wrist.
